descripcion: PETER STREET, 5. Una muerte confirmada, y es LA QUE NO ENCAJA: cae lejos del racimo y el cerco del plano la deja fuera.
_por_que_esta_puesta_a_proposito: Caso que no cuadra, a propósito: cae fuera del círculo y no se esconde.
_guion: Texto del Guion jugable del Acto I.

abre.texto: You are a long way from your end of the parish, Reverend.

opciones.texto: Has anyone in this house died?

cada_calle.texto: Good. Nobody has come down here to count before.

opciones.texto: Has there been a death in this house?

el_marido.texto: My husband, John Marsh. He died on Sunday afternoon. No one else on this part of Peter Street has been ill. I have asked.

opciones.texto: I am sorry for your loss.

el_trabajo.texto: At home we drink from the Peter Street pump. But he worked on Broad Street, and drank from the Broad Street pump all day.

adios.texto: Thank you for coming down here.
